# iamBitchX

> iamBitchX is a BitchX-style Matrix client for the terminal: IRC
> vocabulary (channels, /join, /msg, /slap, /away), Matrix underneath,
> end-to-end encrypted. A fork of iamb (https://iamb.chat) by Ulyssa,
> built on matrix-rust-sdk. Apache-2.0. Written in Rust; releases for
> x86_64/aarch64 Linux, x86_64 macOS and x86_64 Windows.

## Features

### Matrix
- End-to-end encryption (Olm/Megolm via matrix-rust-sdk); /encrypt enables it in a channel
- SAS emoji verification (/verify list|start|accept|yes|no|cancel); incoming requests are offered, never auto-accepted
- Cross-signing and key backup enabled at login; /trust shows status; /recover KEY imports secrets from secure backup
- /devices [USER] lists devices and keys
- Rooms as #channels; DMs via /msg and /query
- /list searches the public room directory; spaces are tagged [space] in /list, /channels and their window
- /join (alias or room id), /part, /topic, /invite, /kick, /op, /deop (power levels), /names, /who, /whois
- /create #x [-public] [-noencrypt]: new channel on your own homeserver, invite-only and encrypted by default; /join of a missing #x on your own server offers to create it [y/n]
- /alias add|del, /publish on|off (room directory), /ban, /unban, /kickban, /power NICK 0..100 (refused above your own level)
- /ignore NICK|@user:server and /unignore NICK use the Matrix account ignore list (m.ignored_user_list); bare /ignore lists it; messages from ignored users are also hidden client-side
- /mode maps IRC modes to Matrix room state: +i invite-only (join rule), +m moderated (events_default 50), +t topic lock, +o op, +b ban; bare /mode and the status bar show the modes (e.g. +it)
- Read-only channels: a refused send says which power level is needed
- Presence: away/online sent and shown
- History backfill when a window opens
- Reactions: shown as `* nick reacted KEY to "short quote"`; /react KEY [N] reacts to the last or Nth-last message
- Typing: `[typing: nick, nick]` in the status bar; typing notices sent while the input has text (/set SEND_TYPING ON|OFF)
- Read receipts: m.read + m.fully_read for the newest event of the active window (/set SEND_RECEIPTS ON|OFF)
- Not supported (yet): threads, edits, media upload/download

### Login
- Password (prompted, or password_file in the config)
- SSO (single sign-on via browser)
- OAuth 2.0 / next-gen Matrix auth (MSC3861) with a local loopback redirect
- Device link: OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628) - the terminal shows a URL and a code; approve in any browser (works over ssh / headless)
- Proactive token refresh; session.json shared safely between processes via a lock file

### IRC / BitchX
- /slap NICK: the BitchX "Brown Cow" slap, sent as /me
- /mircslap NICK: the classic "large trout" slap, sent as /me
- /away [msg] and /back; AWAY_NICK swaps the display name (default %n^afk)
- AUTO_AWAY: auto-away after AUTO_AWAY_TIME seconds idle (default 600) with AUTO_AWAY_MSG
- /me (/action), /channels, /window next|prev, /clear, /close, /quit, /version, /help
- /set vars: TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP_STRING, AUTO_REPLY, BEEP
- /lastlog [-i] TEXT: search the current window, hits shown with their timestamps; /lastlog -clear removes them
- /set LOG ON|OFF, LOG_DIR: irssi-style logs, one plain-text file per window (LOG_DIR/server/#chan.log, DMs too), files 0600, dirs 0700, debug output never logged
- /theme with live preview: 62 iamb themes plus 'terminal'
- /ctcp is recognised but reports "Not supported on Matrix"
